From Lovers · Price: damage to you is also shared with the host.

Theme Affliction

  • 1: 1 action: link with a creature by touch for 1 minute: the link tears into its nerves for @Damage[(1+floor((@actor.level - 1)/4))d6[mental]] damage (@Check[will|against:stand|basic]{basic Will}); on a failure it's linked. When you take damage, it takes half that much (no save). The host is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{off-guard} to you and your stand while linked.
  • 5: The host is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{clumsy 1} while linked, flinching with your pain. Link two creatures.
  • 9: Surge: you transfer one condition from you to the host (@Check[will|against:stand]{Will} negates). A host takes the full damage you take.
  • 13: Link three creatures.
  • 17: No change.

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC. A minion an ability makes, unless it says otherwise, is a creature of your level – 2 built with GM Core's Low numbers (Building Creatures), with the minion trait.
